title: Agent takes a video's start frame: the sidecar's startFrame when it has one, else frame 0 as a new picture card
description: Follow-up to MPI-979 (Fabio, 2026-09-29). Asked to edit the first frame of a video, the agent should use the clip's start frame: the startFrame image its sidecar records (i2v input, full resolution, already in the gallery), and only when there is none, extract frame 0 into a new picture card. A frame from the middle of a clip stays the user's job (right-click Create snapshot): the agent cannot know which frame is meant. Rejected as overkill: searching the gallery for a matching picture when the sidecar has none.
